titleBar.closeWait: Wait until the installation is complete

welcome.label: Welcome
welcome.title: This computer, on all your screens.
welcome.lead: From a phone, a tablet, a TV or another computer, you get this screen as if it were right in front of you: the picture in a few milliseconds, and a keyboard, mouse and gamepad that respond instantly.
welcome.note: Three minutes. Nothing changes on this computer until you click Install.
welcome.problemOne: One issue prevents proper streaming: see the details above.
welcome.problemMany: {count} issues prevent proper streaming: see the details above.

reinstall.label: Reinstallation
reinstall.title: KyberNow Station {version} is already here.
reinstall.lead: Your devices already know this computer. What should we do with its settings?
reinstall.keepDetail: Accounts, paired devices, certificate, Admin settings and ports ({ports}) stay as they are. Only the programs, the drivers and Kyber's fixes are replaced.
reinstall.keepImpossible: Not possible here: this installation's settings cannot be found.
reinstall.freshDetail: New account, new ports, new certificate, default settings.
reinstall.freshWarning: All your devices (Mac, Apple TV, browsers) will lose access: you will need to pair them again with the new account. The Admin and Kyber settings go back to those of a first installation.

account.label: Your account
account.title: One account for everything.
account.lead: No one else on your network will be able to open this computer.
account.hint: {strength}. Only a hash of it is stored.
account.passwordShort: The password must be at least 10 characters long.
account.consoleDetail: For the virtual display, sound, accounts. You can add more accounts there.

options.label: Options
options.title: The best settings are already chosen.
options.lead: You can change it all later in KyberNow Admin.
options.virtualDisplay: Virtual display matched to each device
options.virtualDisplayDetail: The picture arrives at the device's resolution and refresh rate. The free SudoVDA driver is not signed by Microsoft: its certificate will be added to the trusted authorities.
options.gamepadsDetail: Xbox or PlayStation, seen as real gamepads (ViGEmBus driver). A restart may be required.
options.audioDetail: The computer goes silent, the sound goes to the device, up to 7.1. Uses Steam's speakers, found on this computer.
options.audioMissing: Requires Steam, which provides signed virtual speakers. Without it, sound also comes out of the computer.
options.startWithWindowsDetail: Available even before you sign in to Windows. The KyberNow Station tray icon appears near the clock.
options.maxPerformanceDetail: The processor and the graphics card do not slow down during a session: steady latency.
options.maxPerformanceAlready: Already set: this computer is in High performance mode.

files.title: Kyber 0.29 streaming engine
files.text: The engine, its video libraries and the web client go into C:\Program Files\KyberNow.

cert.title: This computer's certificate
cert.text: It encrypts everything exchanged between your devices and this computer.

service.title: Start with the computer
service.text: The Station becomes a service: it starts on its own, even before you sign in to Windows.

firewall.title: Network
firewall.text: Opening ports {stream} (stream) and {console} (Admin), on your private network only.

vdd.title: Virtual display
vdd.text: It will take the size of each device that connects.

audio.title: Remote sound
audio.text: Steam's virtual speakers: the computer goes silent, the device gets the sound.

admin.title: KyberNow Admin
admin.text: Administration in the browser, on port {port}.

power.title: Power
power.text: High performance mode avoids slowdowns during a session.
power.warn: Windows refuses this mode here: unchanged, everything else is installed

install.titleRunning: This computer, soon on all your screens.
install.leadDone: The streaming engine, Admin and the drivers are installed.
install.leadRunning: KyberNow Station is setting up. Nothing to do: we show you each step as it happens.
install.remainingLong: Less than a minute to go

done.label: Installation complete
done.title: This computer is ready. It is everywhere.
done.lead: Open KyberNow Link on any of your devices: this computer is already there. Otherwise, its address:
done.reboot: Gamepads will work after the next restart. Everything else is already active.
done.phoneNote: A certificate warning appears the first time: that is normal.

roles.kybernow: KyberNow Station (installer, tray icon) and KyberNow Admin

about.note: KyberNow is distributed under the AGPL-3.0. The licence texts are installed in C:\Program Files\KyberNow\licenses.

simulation.gpu: NVIDIA GeForce RTX (simulation) · NVENC hardware encoding
simulation.ports: The usual port 8080 is already in use by httpd.exe. Drawn at random and checked free: stream {stream} · Admin {console}
simulation.powerDetail: The GPU slows down to save energy, which can triple the encoding time. We will offer to change it at the Options step.
simulation.audioDetail: Steam's virtual speakers are available: during the stream, the PC goes silent and the sound goes out in stereo, 5.1 or 7.1.
simulation.existingDetail: At the next step, you will choose to keep your settings and devices, or to start from scratch.
simulation.samePort: The stream and Admin need two different ports.
simulation.portInUse: Port 8080 is already in use by httpd.exe.
